name: 63043 · Maryland Hts, MO
findings: ZIP 63043 (Maryland Hts) has 104 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63043 (Maryland Hts) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 63043 (Maryland Hts) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 63043 (Maryland Hts) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list public events, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
